title: A sensitivity audit of The 50 Best Restaurants voting system: code and data
description: Code, data and working draft for a sensitivity audit of the voting system behind The 50 Best Restaurants (The World's 50 Best Restaurants until September 2026). The published lists 2002-2026 are assembled from the organiser's archive with documented corrections. The audit separates four levels of evidence: the published rules and lists, limits on the resolution of the list that hold under any distribution of votes, a binomial model of panel noise under scenarios for that distribution, and a global sensitivity analysis (exact factorial Sobol' indices and optimal-transport indices) of the voting rules with a Plackett-Luce ballot model calibrated to the 2026 list. Archived copies of the web sources (Internet Archive) are listed in data/raw/archived_sources.csv.
